title: spt01_provisioning_test.zig TC-SPT-01-07 expects empty tenant context to resolve search_path to tenant_default, but src/db/pool.zig intentionally implements empty-context-means-public
summary: Discovered while implementing and verifying the ISS-0095 fix (GitHub #349). tests/integration/spt01_provisioning_test.zig's TC-SPT-01-07 explicitly clears tenant context to an empty string after makePool() has already run, then asserts that pool.acquire() resolves search_path to 'tenant_default'. src/db/pool.zig's connection-acquire routing logic (around lines 155-176, applyRequestStorageRouting-equivalent) documents and implements the opposite behavior on purpose: an empty/absent tenant id is treated as the 'no resolved tenant' branch, which sets search_path TO public, not to any tenant schema (including tenant_default). This is a pre-existing test/implementation contract mismatch, unrelated to the ISS-0095 fix (the test explicitly overrides tenant context back to empty after makePool()'s own correct .set() call runs, so ISS-0095's fix has no bearing on this test case either way).

root_cause.details: Resolved by design-doc/git-history investigation (2026-07-31). TC-SPT-01-07 was written against the original SPT-01 design (src/design/spt-01-schema-per-tenant-provisioning.md, commit 398e613, 2026-06-05), which specified empty tenant_id -> 'tenant_default'. That routing function (applyRequestTenantContext) was deliberately superseded by the ISS-501 design (src/design/iss501_storage_mode_routing.md, commit 01cf924, 2026-06-12, 'SPT coexistence'), which explicitly renamed/refactored it into applyRequestStorageRouting() and defines, in its own 'No-tenant path (tenant_id empty / default UUID)' section (lines 61-65): 'SET search_path TO public', with scope note (line 11) 'requests without a resolved tenant continue to use the public-schema-only path' for backward compatibility. src/db/pool.zig:171-178 implements this ISS-501 rule correctly and intentionally. No commit since 01cf924 (2026-06-12) has reversed this. Therefore src/db/pool.zig is correct; TC-SPT-01-07's assertion is the stale artifact, left over from the pre-ISS-501 world and never updated when the routing function was refactored. schemaNameForTenant()'s doc comment (pool.zig:120-128), which still describes empty-string -> tenant_default, is also stale/misleading dead-code-path documentation on the empty-string case (it remains correct and reachable only for non-empty resolved tenant IDs on the SCHEMA path, pool.zig:223).

files_to_change: tests/integration/spt01_provisioning_test.zig -- TC-SPT-01-07: update to assert search_path resolves to 'public' (not 'tenant_default') for empty tenant context, matching ISS-501's documented no-tenant path; update the test's doc comment and name to reflect the corrected expectation.

src/db/pool.zig -- schemaNameForTenant() doc comment (lines 120-128): clarify that the empty-string mapping to 'tenant_default' is unreachable from applyRequestStorageRouting()'s no-tenant path (which short-circuits to public before calling this helper), to prevent future readers from re-deriving the same stale assumption.

tests/specs/SPT-01.md -- TC-SPT-01-07 table row (line 19) and detail section (lines 84-90): same stale tenant_default expectation and pre-ISS-501 function name (applyRequestTenantContext) found independently by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR during Step 2b review; must be corrected alongside the test file to prevent the same drift recurring.
resolution: Corrected TC-SPT-01-07 to assert search_path resolves to 'public' for empty tenant context, matching the ISS-501 no-tenant-path design (src/design/iss501_storage_mode_routing.md). No production code changed -- src/db/pool.zig's applyRequestStorageRouting() was already correct. Clarified schemaNameForTenant()'s doc comment to note its empty-string case is unreachable from the no-tenant routing path. Corrected the matching stale expectation and pre-ISS-501 function name in tests/specs/SPT-01.md (found independently by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR during design review). Verified via full zig build test-integration run: TC-SPT-01-07 passes; no regressions introduced (failure count consistent with the pre-existing baseline documented in tests/reports/report-iss0095-20260731-WF03-iss0095-20260731.yaml one commit earlier). One unrelated pre-existing defect (TC-SPT-01-06 storage_mode fallback drift) was discovered during verification and filed separately as ISS-0099 / GitHub #355.

occurrences.context: Found by BACKEND-DEV while implementing the ISS-0095 fix, confirmed unrelated since the test explicitly re-clears tenant context after makePool()'s own (now-correct) .set() call, specifically to exercise the empty-context code path as its own test subject.

prevention: When a test explicitly asserts behavior for an edge case (like empty/absent tenant context), cross-check the assertion against the implementation's own doc comments before merging the test, not after it starts failing in an unrelated fix's full-suite run.

When a routing/design refactor (e.g. ISS-501) supersedes an earlier function's documented contract, grep for and update every test spec and integration test that encoded the earlier contract's expectations at the same time as the refactor -- not months later when a mismatch is stumbled into. tests/specs/*.md drifts silently because it is not compiled or executed.
